# Who I work with

## Real-time tools, delays and nowcasting {.smaller}

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
![](../figures/exchange-people-grid-a.jpg){width="84%" fig-align="center"
fig-alt="Six collaborators on real-time tools and hubs: Sebastian Funk,

- Five of these six are `EpiNow2` co-authors. Nikos Bosse wrote

- Sebastian Funk, Samuel Brand and Kath Sherratt are co-authors on the
  live DRC model. Katelyn Gostic is at CDC

- Adrian Lison and Adam Howes are second only to me on `epinowcast`

- `primarycensored` is joint work with Thomas Ward, UKHSA, and
